item.title: Neurostimulation may offer lasting pain relief for chronic low back pain
item.description: A study reports that restorative neurostimulation provides durable improvements in pain, disability, and quality of life over five years in real-world patients.

item.title: Prior GLP-1 use does not alter bariatric surgery outcomes
item.description: Patients with and without prior GLP-1 treatment achieve similar weight loss after bariatric surgery, according to Medscape Medical News.

item.title: Emotion-regulation training reduces distress and alters brain activity
item.description: A five-week training program helped college students regulate emotions better, leading to reduced distress and measurable brain changes, a new study finds.

item.title: Women hold few leadership roles in structural heart disease trials
item.description: Women occupy less than 10% of oversight committee positions in interventional structural heart disease trials, despite increasing female representation in studies.
